title:
THE MILES
COUNTY
MASSACRE.
label: A MILES COUNTY DOSSIER
alt: Art the Clown waits beside a foggy Miles County road
tag: One silent clown. A town with no clean exits.
copy: Damien Leone’s gleefully vicious Terrifier universe—black sack, greasepaint grin, and practical carnage that made Art an icon.

title:
TALK
TO ME.
label: THE HAND / OPEN CHANNEL 002
alt: Original eerie hand and spirit-world artwork for Talk to Me
tag: You let it in. Now make it leave.
copy: A party trick becomes a possession ritual in the Philippou brothers’ sharp, feral take on grief, peer pressure, and viral horror.

title: LONGLEGS.
label: THE HARKER FILE / EVIDENCE 003
alt: Original moonlit forest and isolated house artwork for Longlegs
tag: A little nightmare for a little girl.
copy: Osgood Perkins turns a serial-killer investigation into a dread-soaked occult puzzle, with a performance from Nicolas Cage that crawls under your skin.

title:
THE
SUBSTANCE.
label: MIRROR ROOM / FORMULA 04
alt: Original fractured mirror and transformation artwork for The Substance
tag: Have you ever dreamt of a better version of yourself?
copy: Coralie Fargeat’s grotesque body-horror spiral turns the pursuit of youth into a candy-colored, practical-effects meltdown.

title:
EVIL DEAD
RISE.
label: THE DEADITES / APARTMENT 5
alt: Original haunted apartment and demon-shadow artwork for Evil Dead Rise
copy: Lee Cronin drags the Deadites into a cramped Los Angeles apartment for a nasty, full-volume family siege.

title:
TRAIN TO
BUSAN.
label: LAST STOP / EVIDENCE 006
copy: A relentless siege on rails. Yeon Sang-ho’s zombie sprint balances breathless action with a bruising story about who we choose to protect.

title:
3 FROM
HELL.
label: THE FIREFLY FAMILY / FINAL FILE 007
alt: Official 3 from Hell theatrical poster: Baby, Otis, and Foxy against a red flame-like background
copy: Rob Zombie brings the Firefly family back for one last road trip through desert dust, busted neon, and grindhouse mayhem. The final chapter of the House of 1000 Corpses trilogy.
